mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cards (user_id, trip_id, photo_id, stored_filename, content_type, size_bytes, width, height) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tripId}, #{photoId}, #{storedFilename}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{width}, #{height})
mapper.update: UPDATE cards SET stored_filename = #{storedFilename}, content_type = #{contentType}, size_bytes = #{sizeBytes}, width = #{width}, height = #{height} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, trip_id, photo_id, stored_filename, content_type, size_bytes, width, height, created_at, updated_at FROM cards WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, user_id, trip_id, photo_id, stored_filename, content_type, size_bytes, width, height, created_at, updated_at FROM cards WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} ORDER BY created_at, id

SELECT t.id AS trip_id, t.title, t.start_date, t.end_date, t.region, t.theme, COUNT(c.id) AS card_count, cover.id AS cover_card_id, cover.width AS cover_width, cover.height AS cover_height FROM trips t LEFT JOIN cards c ON c.trip_id = t.id LEFT JOIN cards cover ON cover.id = ( SELECT c2.id FROM cards c2 WHERE c2.trip_id = t.id ORDER BY c2.updated_at DESC, c2.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.status = 'past' GROUP BY t.id, t.title, t.start_date, t.end_date, t.region, t.theme, cover.id, cover.width, cover.height ORDER BY COALESCE(MAX(c.updated_at), t.end_date, t.start_date) DESC, t.id DESC
SELECT stored_filename FROM cards WHERE trip_id = #{tripId}
SELECT stored_filename FROM cards WHERE user_id = #{userId}
